# Maize Bipolaris disease-progress data

Source record for the public maize disease-progress dataset used by `crop-protection-predictive-science`.

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/emdelponte/paper-hgam-curves
- Upstream commit pinned by the consuming project: `d793d54c17ad404df2f6618d2681c993fcf144cf`
- Source path: `maize_bipolaris.csv`
- Upstream repository licence: MIT

The consuming project deliberately vendors the exact Git object for offline scientific reproducibility. The central data repository therefore records provenance but does not create another byte copy.
